propositions: A `recheck-review` Gerrit comment token allows contributors to manually retrigger LLM-Review on the same patchset when a -1 vote was cast for infrastructure reasons (coverage-gap sub-reasons) rather than a real finding.

The retrigger eligibility gate must refuse re-review only for current-revision LLM-Review BLOCK findings (both bare and merge-change forms), reading the durable vote tag from Gerrit's authoritative message record to prevent contributor forgery.
The retrigger path resets the shared per-revision retry budget from ticket 0347 before enqueueing a forced re-review, harmonizing with the bounded automatic retry mechanism.
The reply comment path must post a message-only body with no `labels` key to avoid vote writes, maintaining the vote-free invariant of contributor-initiated triggers.

The `retrigger.py` tag parser must handle all three production tag shapes: `_TAG_SUFFIXES` vocabulary, hardcoded `merge-review` literals, and merge-change suffixes inside the brackets, failing open on unparseable tags to re-review safely.
Operator activation requires re-running `infra/gerrit/service-user.sh` to push the updated `webhooks.config` (with `comment-added` event) to `refs/meta/config`; until then the trigger is inert.
